```python
import sys

def main():
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    seen = set()
    unique = True
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        remainder = n % i
        if remainder in seen:
            unique = False
            break
        seen.add(remainder)
    print("Yes" if unique else "No")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    k = int(input[1])
    seen = set()
    valid = True
    for i in range(1, k+1):
        remainder = n % i
        if remainder not in seen:
            seen.add(remainder)
        else:
            valid = False
            break
    print("Yes" if valid else "No")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
